cases.name: Tequesha Simone Boxill
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "(She was) an employee with the Philadelphia Parking Authority, died on Tuesday, March 12, 2024. She was 43.

She was affectionately known as Quesha and Tweet by family members and friends. She was born on Sept. 12, 1980, to Wayne Boxill and Jennifer McDougall in the U.S. Virgin Island of St. Croix.

She was raised by her father in Philadelphia and was educated in the Philadelphia public school system. She graduated from John Bartram High School. She also attended Lincoln Technical Institutes’ pharmacy technician program.

Boxill worked in customer service in various retail stores until beginning her career with the Philadelphia Parking Authority in 2011. She also worked the polls in her community during elections.

She was a fashion diva and created her own stylish designs. One of her favorite pastimes was visiting New York for fashion inspirations and to shop. She loved all genres of music, sharing them with her close friends and family. Spending time with family and friends was always the highlight of her day.

“Quesha was small in stature but had a huge heart, a force to be reckoned with, a fierce, loving personality,” her family said in a tribute. “To know her was to know love; it may be tough love at times, but it was all love.”

“She cared about all that she called her family, friend or acquaintance,” the tribute continued. “She cared about how you felt, how you looked, and was willing to help you get there. She made sure you were taken care of and had a way of keeping you focused.”
cases.narrative: On 3/12/2024, during a welfare check police found her unresponsive in the hallway near her apartment door on the first floor.
